sentences.text:
Pabitra Halder vs Unknown on 10 July, 2025
10.07.2025 Sl. no. 22 P.M. C.R.M. (M) 770 Of 2025 In Re : An application for bail under Section
439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik
Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Hanskhali Police Station Case No. 527 of 2024 dated
14.07.2024 under Sections 363/365/376/506/323/325/376D/384 / 354D/354B/120B of the Indian
Penal Code corresponding to S.C. No. 26(08) 2024 pending before the Learned Additional Sessions
Judge, Ranaghat, Nadia.

And In the matter of : Pabitra Halder .... Petitioner Mr. Prabir Majumder, Mr. Snehansu Majumder,
Mr. Debraj Shil Ms. Anindita Kundu ....
For the petitioner Mr. Ranabir Roy Chowdhury, Ms. Sima Biswas ... for the State Affidavit of service filed in court is taken on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is seeking bail on the ground that the petitioner is in custody for the last more than 300 days.
Learned counsel submits that admittedly the petitioner has not committed sexual assault upon the victim.
Learned counsel for the State submits that as per statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. the present petitioner is a principal perpetrator of the offence.
Learned counsel also submits that the date is fixed before the learned Trial Court is on 14 th July, 2025 for examination of the victim.
Let the matter be placed before the regular Bench on 24 th July, 2025.
Learned trial court is directed to complete the testimony of the witnesses on 14th July, 2025.
Learned counsel for the State is requested to convey the order to the learned trial Court.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
